verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides building blocks an AI-native user could combine into a faster close. AgentOS and its documented MCP server let agents act on the production account, including building cashflow reports. The Card Expenses API retrieves approved expenses and marks them synced to an ERP or accounting system, and spend docs mention reconciling expenses and accounts payable. There is no evidence of a first-party AI feature aimed at month-end close, so the user must assemble the automation themselves. Missing for 10: native AI-driven reconciliation or close workflows, documented accounting-software integrations (e.g., ledger sync or categorization), end-to-end close examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
